description: Follow https://www.superlogical.com/rex/docs/linux/installation#nix-and-nixos: add the rex flake input (snapshot), import its home-manager module everywhere, run a personal server (HM services.rex) with linger on every NixOS host (shirka, ash-devbox, spectre-devbox). Macs keep the app's CLI (programs.rex.package = null). Rework home-modules/programs/rex.nix to extend upstream's programs.rex instead of declaring it.
title: Install Rex on NixOS hosts via its flake (personal server)
